svg.title: Softmax feature embeddings: a regular embedder next to a feature groups embedder, whose softmax groups show how confident the model is. Image adapted from the author; values are illustrative.
svg.desc: With feature groups, each softmax block is like a one-hot feature. A clear peak in a group (the "max" labels) means the model is confident about that feature, the same reading as a classifier with a softmax. With feature groups, each softmax block is like a one-hot feature. A clear peak in a group (the "max" labels) means the model is confident about that feature, the same reading as a classifier with a softmax. The same groups on an unsure prediction: the values in each group are close to each other and no peak stands out (low "max" values), so the model is not confident about those features.
